title: Multi-Behavioral Evolved Substrates Through Neuromodulation and Activation Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.00148v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-ended artificial life systems must acquire diverse competencies from a single evolving genotype. Biological brains combine neuromodulation, which reconfigures circuits without changing connections, with diverse neuron types matched to specific computational roles. Can artificial evolution achieve something analogous in indirectly encoded substrates?   Using indirectly encoded substrates evolved via CPPNs, we show through more than 10,000 experiments that neuromodulation alone is insufficient: under evolutionary search, monotonic activation functions impose a 75% ceiling on parity tasks that persists regardless of capacity, topology, or population size. This is an evolutionary search barrier, not a representational limit, since Adam gradient descent achieves 100% on the identical architecture. translated_title: 通过神经调节与激活函数选择实现多行为演化基底
translated_abstract: 开放式人工生命系统必须从单一演化基因型中获取多样化能力。生物大脑结合了神经调节（可在不改变连接的情况下重新配置神经回路）以及与特定计算角色相匹配的多样化神经元类型。人工演化能否在间接编码的基底中实现类似机制？我们使用通过CPPN（组合模式生成网络）演化的间接编码基底，通过超过10,000次实验表明，仅靠神经调节是不够的：在演化搜索条件下，单调激活函数对奇偶性任务施加了75%的性能上限，且无论网络容量、拓扑结构或种群规模如何变化，该上限始终存在。这是一个演化搜索障碍，而非表征能力的限制，因为Adam梯度下降在完全相同的架构上可以达到100%的性能。我们将神经调节与针对每个任务的激活函数选择相结合，将振荡型基元匹配到奇偶性任务，将单调函数匹配到其他任务。
tldr: 该研究通过上万次实验发现，在CPPN演化基底中仅靠神经调节无法突破单调激活函数导致的75%奇偶性任务性能上限（这是演化搜索障碍而非表征限制），而将神经调节与按任务选择激活函数（如为奇偶性任务匹配振荡函数）相结合可以突破这一瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Through over 10,000 experiments, this study shows that neuromodulation alone cannot overcome the 75% ceiling on parity tasks imposed by monotonic activations in evolved CPPN substrates—a search barrier rather than a representational limit—but combining neuromodulation with per-task activation function selection breaks through this bottleneck.
